subject: Private VPC pricing and support banding for Medicore - proposed commercial checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Chu <samantha@medicore.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private VPC pricing: multi-site volume & support tiers

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood stack looks promising for our use case. Procurement asked me to get a clearer commercial picture so they can align internal approvals:

- We expect initial deployment across 3 sites (US East, US West, EU) with a starting footprint ~50 nodes (mix of serving + infra), growth plan to ~120 nodes in 18 months.
- Primary asks: a) platform fee amortization options (annual vs monthly vs prepay), b) support tier pricing and response SLAs by region, c) volume discounts for nodes and a multi-site consolidation credit, d) migration/implementation credits for a multi-site cutover.

Attached is our RFP excerpt with expected timelines and procurement requirements. High level asks: 2-year commitment preferred, but procurement will push for as much amortization/crediting as possible in year one.

Can you share a starting price band and whether Redwood can offer a measurable implementation credit or a first-year support retainer discount?

Thanks,
Samantha Chu
Head of Platform Engineering
Medicore

Attachment: Medicore_RFP.pdf
From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chu <samantha@medicore.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing: multi-site volume & support tiers

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear RFP. We're excited about the potential to partner with Medicore. Quick clarifying Qs before I pull together a scoped sheet for procurement:

1) For the node counts you listed, can you confirm whether the 50-node starting footprint is an average sustained expectation or a burst/peak config?
2) Do you require KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 evidence to be included in the SOW? (helps us size the security add-on)
3) Any timing constraints on invoicing (Net30 vs Net45) or PO/POC requirements we should be aware of?

I can get a proposed commercial checklist and a draft term sheet over by EOD Monday after internal alignment.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Medicore RFP — proposed concessions and margin impact (internal)

Team — forwarding Samantha's RFP. Procurement is pushing for strong amortization and implementation credits. My proposed commercial levers:

- Commit: 2-year term with growth triggers (50 -> 120 nodes). Require a 30% upfront prepayment to unlock deeper discounts.
- Platform fee: standard platform fee amortized monthly but offer a 12% list discount if they prepay 30% of year1. Without prepay, offer 6% discount for 2-year commit.
- Support: offer S2 (24x7 + 2hr escalation) at 20% discount in year1 if they accept 2-year commit and a 6-month rollout window; year2 reverts to list or negotiated uplift based on footprint.
- Migration credit: one-time $25k credit applied to year1 invoice if internal delivery is within our standard scope. For anything custom beyond our standard runbook, we bill T&M.
- Multi-site consolidation credit: $15k for adding EU site within 6 months.

Margin check: at 12% platform discount + $25k credit we're looking at ~9% reduction EV on year1 revenue. Karthik — can you confirm whether CFO can approve up to 12% in discount for strategic accounts or we need EPD signoff?
Marissa — recommend we hold Net30 in contract but be flexible to Net45 if procurement insists; that reduces cash velocity risk.

Please reply with edits. I want to finalize term sheet and send to Samantha Tuesday midday.

Laura

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chu <samantha@medicore.com>
Cc: Medicore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed commercial checklist — Redwood private VPC (Medicore)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the patience. Per our internal review, here's a compact commercial checklist we can present to procurement. If this looks acceptable I can push a formal term sheet and DocuSign to you.

Key commercial terms (summary):
- Term: 24 months.
- Footprint: initial 50 nodes across 3 sites; projected 120 nodes by month 18.
- Pricing:
  - Node licensing: $1,750 per node / month list (serving+infra blended).
  - Platform fee: $45,000 / month list.
  - Discounting: 12% off platform fee for 30% year1 prepayment and signed 24-month commit. If no prepay: 6% off platform with 24-month commit.
- Support: S2 (24x7, 2-hr escalation) — list $120k/year. Offer 25% discount on support retainer year1 (transition discount) if commit is signed within 30 days. Year2 reverts to list unless usage triggers an uplift.
- Credits: one-time implementation/migration credit of $25,000 applied to year1 invoice; multi-site consolidation credit $15,000 if EU site goes live within 6 months.
- Payment terms: Net30 preferred. We'll consider Net45 on a case-by-case basis for procurement.
- Security add-ons: KMS/HSM integration and SOC2 artifacts available as billable add-ons — estimate to be included after scope confirmation.

Next steps: I can attach a draft term sheet (with line-item pricing and a simple SOW appendix) and a DocuSign envelope for signature. Please let me know whether procurement will require Net45 and whether the 30% prepayment is acceptable.

Attachment: Redwood_VPC_TermSheet_20270211.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Chu <samantha@medicore.com>

Laura — thanks, this is helpful and much clearer for procurement. A few quick notes from Procurement:

- They like the 24-month commitment and the migration credit.
- Procurement will formally request Net45 on PO (they have internal cashflow windows this quarter). Is Redwood willing to accept Net45 in the contract?
- A tiny ask: can the platform fee discount be moved to 14% if we confirm EU site live within 90 days (instead of 180)? They can add that as a clause (timebound incentive).

If you can route the DocuSign with Net45 and the alternative clause for 14% conditional credit for faster EU rollout we can route to legal and procurement for signature next week.

Samantha
